title: Conjecture 9.2
statement_text: A digraph is 2-extremal if and only if it is in $\mathcal{H}_2$.
context_text: The paper defines $\mathcal{H}_2$ as the smallest class containing symmetric odd cycles and closed under directed Hajós joins and 2-Hajós tree joins. Its main theorem characterizes $k$-extremal digraphs for $k=1$ and $k\geq 3$; Conjecture 9.2 proposes the missing characterization for $k=2$.
